name: Peter Shimwell
bio: Peter Shimwell is a board member with experience in operations, technology, and scaling community services.
longBio:
Peter Shimwell is a board member with experience in operations, technology, and scaling community services. He has supported teams rolling out digital tools to improve service delivery and is focused on practical systems that help rangatahi get support faster.

Peter brings a solutions mindset to Kick Back, backing the mahi with process design and technical know-how.
